profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer with experience building fintech and trading platforms using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and C#/.NET.

Currently working across futures and margin trading products, with experience building customer-facing trading interfaces, administrative tools, and backend systems. I’ve also led frontend modernization efforts, including migrating a large React application from JavaScript to TypeScript.

Previously worked in financial analysis and hold a degree in MIS and Finance, giving me a strong foundation for building products at the intersection of software and financial markets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a lightweight, un-opinionated Deno third party module that modifies GraphQL responses, making error message more descriptive and less ambiguous
- Leveraged Deno runtime for its event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, as well its out of the box TypeScript, decentralized package management, and increased security
- Implemented a GraphQL API allowing clients to make HTTP requests to a strongly typed schema that delivers efficient payloads from multiple data sources

Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io

positions.title: Portfolio Evaluation Associate
positions.description:
- Developed custom algorithms to automate the production of portfolio analysis documents, saving team an estimated 5,000+ hours per year
- Lead technical team in improving and maintaining portfolio analysis document production tools while managing various projects using Agile Scrum methodologies, overseeing bug backlogs, and creating and conducting technical training for new team members
